details:
designed and built Artemis & Mars Outpost Commander, an interactive 3D lunar and Martian outpost simulation grounded in real NASA open datasets for students ages 7 to 12, families, and classrooms.

Key Features Built

  • Interactive 3D Outpost Scene (Three.js):
    • Two Selectable Landing Sites: Artemis Base Camp (Shackleton Rim, Lunar South Pole) and Ares Station (Jezero River Delta, Mars) with site-accurate lighting, regolith micro-relief textures, horizon fog, one-way radio delay (1.3 sec vs. 14 min 20 sec), and baseline radiation rates.
    • 6 Composite Multi-Part 3D Modules: Core Habitat Dome, ECLSS Oxygen & Water Refinery, Water-Wall Radiation Bunker with rotating active magnetic coil, OSDR Hydroponic Bio-Dome with glowing Mizuna crop racks, Articulated Vertical Solar Array Wing, and Ka-Band Deep-Space Dish with a 6-wheeled Pressurized Rover.
    • Power Bus Allocation: Players split limited solar wattage across ECLSS Life Support (O2 & Water), Water-Wall & Magnetic Shielding, OSDR Hydroponics Bio-Dome LEDs, and Rovers & Deep Space Comms.
    • 8 Sols of Real NASA Mission Dilemmas: Every Sol presents a real constraint drawn from NASA DONKI (M8.4 and X5.8 solar flares and proton storms), NASA OSDR (OSD-379 Veggie/Mizuna CO2 scrubbing, OSD-412 microalgae photobioreactors), and Artemis / Perseverance MEDA telemetry where no option is free.
    • Traceable NASA Science & Kid Glossary: Live/archived DONKI solar flare polling (/api/nasa/live) and plain-language definitions for Sol, MilliSievert (mSv), Coronal Mass Ejection (CME), ECLSS, Regolith, and Hydroponics.
    • Server-Side Gemini Mission Intelligence, High Thinking, TTS & 1K/2K/4K Image Lab: Routes for gemini-4-carbon with ThinkingLevel.HIGH, gemini-4-argon, gemini-4-hydrogen, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-3.8-flash-tts audio briefings, and gemini-3-pro-image-preview with 1K, 2K, and 4K resolution controls (with deterministic NASA Mission Control engineering analysis and CAD schematics when a paid API key is not attached).
